outlierReview: Each returned to 15 processes at the next minute; extra service children were gone at supplemental sampling except the normal active fixture Node process. Exact transient command names were not captured. All observed process identities exited at final cleanup.
trendReview: Warmup growth did not continue across the four comparable windows; RSS receded, desktop heap median ~21 MiB and Web heap median stabilized ~38-39 MiB. All eleven after-reopen samples had 17 processes / 16 TCP entries, then 15 / 11 at the next minute.
scope: Unpackaged current source bundles, hidden desktop + Electron-hosted Web, fixture models, real local Shell. RSS sums include shared pages and vary with other machine activity. No forced GC, exclusive-machine control, real system sleep, actual notification display or VoiceOver; does not validate original released packages.
